source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of educational inequality (PDF 183).

blocks.text: Taleem ke liye internet aur digital tools tak rasai din ba din zyada zaroori hoti ja rahi hai. Jin students ke paas yeh wasail (resources) nahi, woh bohat nuqsan (disadvantage) mein hain.

Misal: COVID-19 ki waba (pandemic) ke dauran jab Pakistan aur duniya bhar ke school online parhai par chale gaye, to kam aamdani wale khandanon ya dehi ilaqon ke students internet ya devices na hone ki wajah se parhai mein peeche reh gaye. Is se mukhtalif socio-economic (samaji aur maali) groups ke darmiyan taleemi faasla aur barh gaya.

blocks.prompt: MCQ 5: Digital divide taleem par kaise asar dalta hai?
blocks.explanation: (c) Digital learning resources tak rasai mein na-barabari paida karta hai. (Kitab ki answer key yahan (b) “koi asar nahi” deti hai, jo text ke khilaf hai.)

items: Taleemi na-barabari: internet aur devices ke baghair students peeche (COVID-19 mein online classes).
